mapper.select: SELECT board_id FROM boards WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title FROM ( SELECT s.post_id, MAX(s.final_score) AS score FROM stats_post_hourly s WHERE s.board_id = #{boardId} AND s.is_trending = 1 AND s.stat_hour >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY s.post_id ) t JOIN posts p ON p.post_id = t.post_id AND p.state = 'normal' ORDER BY t.score DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title FROM posts p WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId} AND p.state = 'normal' AND p.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY (p.view_count + 5 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.post_id) + 3 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.state = 'normal')) DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.ban_status <> 'permanent' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stats_access_hourly s WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id AND s.access_hour >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) )
